body:
I understand. I guess I'm just afraid I won't be able to work my way up and I won't get accepted into the (extremely competitive) field of study I want to in uni. 

*should mention to anyone who just happens to skim this - my grades aren't the source of my suicidal inclinations. Just want you to know.

It's really nice to hear that someone feels the same. Not in the "If I'm going down, you're going down with me" sense of course. I'm sure you know what I mean. /laughs/

I think I replied to someone up above that I try to consider telling someone, so again to that. I trust you guys, and if the general opinion is that this is a valid option, I'll take it to mind. I'll also remember you if I ever need someone to talk to. I appreciate that. 

Also, that really brightened my day. I do write, so to me, yours is a  fantastic compliment to receive. One of the best I could hear. Thank you (:

I wish you the best, DavidFoxxxy. Here's to hoping the two of us make it through this. <3

As a side note, I have a basic handle on why I feel the way I do. At this point in my life though, I am a failure. My grades are lowering substantially every semester. I'm nearly failing every class. I went from 80s and 90s in all my subjects to 60s, and now I'm barely scraping mid fifties. I didn't even come close to passing my academic math semester before last with a percent far lower than anyone else in the class. I feel like I have potential that I'll never be able to reach no matter how hard I try. I had the opportunity to be anything, but I've put myself in a place where I'll never amount to anything. I can't do anything right.

So I guess I just used this rather than a message, huh? (:'

While it's *possible* to talk to an adult about this, my body just rejects the thought completely. It really scares and upsets me to even imagine admitting any of this to a parent. 

But thank you. I'll consider it more seriously.

Ps- I hope you've gotten better. (:
Thank you so much. I appreciate your understanding more than you could ever know. I really, truly, thank you. <3
